units.source_text: 不知何时，他从伏尔泰的房子的窗口仰望着高山。

en.t: At some point, he looked up at the high mountains from the window of Voltaire's house.

units.source_text: 那挂着冰川的山上，一只秃鹰的影子也没有。

en.t: On those mountains hung with glaciers, there was not even the shadow of a vulture.

units.source_text: 可是上路上可以看到有一个身材矮小的俄罗斯人在顽强地攀登。

en.t: But on the path upward, a short Russian could be seen stubbornly climbing.
